notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped ordinary attribute update and Flush Queue surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies future input delivery before the Flush Queue grant and the optimistic logical-time frontier without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped UpdateAttributeValues and FlushQueueRequest with FederateAmbassador timestamped reflection and flush-grant callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped attribute update/Flush Queue and FederateAmbassador callback declarations
